theater: 陰平小徑、劍閣與成都（蜀道北段）

battle.name: 魏滅蜀漢之戰
battle.theater: 陰平小徑、劍閣與成都（蜀道北段）
battle.brief: 景元四年（263），司馬昭遣鍾會、鄧艾分道伐蜀。鍾會正面壓向劍閣，鄧艾自陰平小徑偷渡摩天嶺，直取綿竹、雒縣，逼劉禪於十一月奉璽出降。卡面月牙劍是埃及外彎單刃短劍，此處代指蜀軍手中的環首刀：砍劈不需拔刃，正是劍閣道上白刃相接的兵器邏輯。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 魏滅蜀漢之戰是曹魏景元四年（263）八月至十一月，司馬昭以鎮西將軍鍾會、征西將軍鄧艾為主，兵分三路滅亡蜀漢的戰役。曹魏一方名義上以魏帝曹奐為主，實權在相國、晉公司馬昭手中：鍾會任大都督，統主力十餘萬自秦嶺南下，循漢中、劍閣正面向成都推進；鄧艾自請為方面統帥，率偏師自陰平小徑迂迴入蜀；中護軍諸葛緒奉命出劍閣以斷姜維退路，兵至沓中後奉鍾會調令北上，卻在涪關被鄧艾擊敗受降，另派監軍衛瓘隨軍監察鍾、鄧二人。蜀漢一方以成都為中樞：後主劉禪居中，丞相姜維領兵屯劍閣、沓中，與大將軍諸葛瞻部形成前後兩道；尚書令董厥、散騎常侍黃崇、侍中向寵等分領成都方向兵將，諸葛瞻率眾至綿竹與鄧艾對峙。蜀軍沿蜀道北段節節設防，劍閣關城為第一樞紐，涪城、綿竹一線為第二道屏障，雒縣與成都為最後依託，劍閣一旦失守，前線與國都之間再無可守之地。
countriesEn: The conquest of Shu Han was fought from the eighth to the eleventh month of Jingyuan 4 (263), when Sima Zhao, the regent of Cao Wei, sent Zhong Hui and Deng Ai against Shu in three columns. On the Wei side the empire was nominally under Emperor Cao Huan, but real power lay with Sima Zhao, who had already moved the emperor to Ye and now issued the orders in the court's name: Zhong Hui was appointed commander-in-chief with a general's tally and led a main force of more than a hundred thousand men down from the Qinling range through Hanzhong towards Jiange; Deng Ai asked to serve as an independent commander and took a detachment around the Yinping track; the colonel Zhongge Xu was sent out of Jiange to cut off Jiang Wei's retreat, and when he reached Tiaozhong he was ordered north to Jiange instead, only to be defeated at Fucheng by Deng Ai and forced to surrender. Wei also attached a commissioner of surveillance, Wei Guan, to the army to check on the two commanders. On the Shu side Chengdu was the hub: the Later Lord Liu Shan stayed in the capital, Chancellor Jiang Wei held the field with the army posted at Jiange and Tiaozhong, and the General of Chariots Zhuge Zhan commanded the troops facing Chengdu, with the Master of Ceremonies Dong Jiao, the Commandant of Cavalry Huang Chong and the Palace Attendant Xiang Chong holding posts in the capital, while Zhuge Zhan brought his men to Mianzhu to meet Deng Ai. The Shu defence followed the northern section of the Shu Road stage by stage: Jiange was the first hinge, Fucheng and Mianzhu the second barrier, and Luoxian and Chengdu the last reliance, for once Jiange fell there was no ground left to hold between the front and the capital.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三方。司馬昭是這場戰爭真正的推手：景元四年春，朝廷以他的名義下詔，兵分三路，同時派監軍衛瓘隨軍制肘；魏帝曹奐自景元初年被遷居鄴城，實為人質，對軍事無權干預。鍾會出身汝南鍾氏，父鍾繇為曹魏重臣，他以鎮西將軍、假節大都督統主力自劍閣正面南下，兵精將強，也在滅蜀途中屢獻策劃。鄧艾時年五十一歲，見鍾會專走劍閣有利可乘，上表力陳陰平小徑可出，鍾會力言「道險，非將軍所宜」，司馬昭終批准他自行決斷，鄧艾遂以孤軍深入而名動天下。蜀方主將姜維為天水人，諸葛亮南征時收之，後繼諸葛亮秉政，屢次北伐，是蜀漢最後一根支柱；大將軍諸葛瞻是諸葛亮之子，與董厥不睦、為黃皓所抑，臨危受命守綿竹，猶豫不決而致敗亡，同死者有其子諸葛尚，散騎常侍黃崇力主出戰亦歿於陣。成都方面，後主劉禪在譙周、黃皓與一班黃門官員之間被架空，接到請降書後終究奉璽出降；譙周曾上疏力言降魏乃「存社稷」，事後仍被挾往洛陽；宦官黃皓的干政被公認為蜀亡內因之一。戰後，監軍衛瓘奉詔逮捕鄧艾，鍾會與姜維又在成都圖謀叛逆，同歸於盡。
peopleEn: Three sets of actors matter here. Sima Zhao was the real author of the campaign: in the spring of Jingyuan 4 the court issued the orders in his name, splitting the army into three columns, while the commissioner Wei Guan went with the force to restrain the two commanders; the Wei emperor Cao Huan had been moved to Ye and was effectively a hostage with no voice in military affairs. Zhong Hui came from the Runan Zhong clan, his father Zhong Yao a heavyweight of the Wei state, and as General Who Pacifies the West with a general's tally he led the main force straight down the Jiange road with the sharpest troops, shaping the war as it unfolded. Deng Ai was fifty-one years old; seeing that the thrust through Jiange opened a chance, he memorialised the court that the Yinping track could be used, and Zhong Hui insisted the road was too dangerous for him. Sima Zhao at last let Deng Ai decide for himself, and that small force going in alone made his name. On the Shu side the decisive commander was Jiang Wei of Tianshui, picked up by Zhuge Liang on his southern expedition and afterwards entrusted with the administration of the state, who had campaigned north many times and was the last pillar of Shu. The General of Chariots Zhuge Zhan, son of Zhuge Liang, was on bad terms with Dong Jiao and was held back by the eunuch Huang Hao; given command of Mianzhu in the emergency he hesitated, was beaten, and died together with his son Zhuge Shang, while the Commandant of Cavalry Huang Chong, who had urged him to give battle, was killed in the same action. In Chengdu the Later Lord Liu Shan had been eclipsed by Qiao Zhou, by Huang Hao and by a clique of eunuchs, and faced with the petition to surrender he finally handed over the imperial seals. Qiao Zhou had argued in writing that surrendering to Wei was the way to preserve the state, and was still carried off to Luoyang afterwards. The interference of the eunuch Huang Hao is commonly counted among the internal causes of Shu's fall. After the war Wei Guan was ordered to arrest Deng Ai, while Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei plotted rebellion at Chengdu and both perished.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），約西元前1500年前後已見於埃及，屬新王國早期形制：銅質或鐵質，單刃，刃身向外彎曲成新月狀，握柄短。它的戰術邏輯是砍下去不必拔出——彎刃吃住對手的盾牌、肢體或兵器，趁勢絞轉、壓迫，一擊即定；它比直劍更早成熟，說明人類先學會用「弧」去控制白刃。三國時代的蜀漢並無此物，兵器譜系上真正對位的是環首刀：漢代以來邊郡與中原軍隊的標準配刀，兩面直刃、刀身平直，環首可繫繩以便連鞘佩帶，主要用於劈砍而非刺擊；曹丕《典論·論文》論及劍與環首刀之別，謂環首刀以剛健見長、可施於戰陣，說明直刃雙邊的長劍仍偏重儀飾與近身直刺。雙方步兵常備者還有長戟、白纓矛、大盾（柳葉盾、板盾）、兜鍪與札甲兩當、匕首；蜀軍的弩最為有名，諸葛亮所創連弩能連發，另有蹶張弩與淬毒箭，魏軍則以強弩、角弓配大量箭矢。攻城與守城的器械也進入戰線：雲梯、攻車、巢車、投石機、霹靂車（曹丕伐吳之役已用之破水軍，見《三國志·武帝紀》裴注引《魏略》）、木製拒馬與鹿角壘。蜀道上的運輸更見特色：蜀軍用木牛流馬運糧，魏軍靠牛車與馬匹馳援；陰平小徑上的木橋、索橋與棧道是雙方爭奪的補給命脈，而刀、矛、戟、弓弩的高低，正是這條窄道上決定生死的最後一段。
kitsEn: The card shows a khopesh, the Egyptian sickle-sword that appears from about 1500 BC and belongs to the early New Kingdom repertoire: bronze or iron, single-edged, with the blade curving outward into a crescent and a short grip. Its tactical logic is that a blow does not need to be pulled back out. The curved edge catches a shield, a limb or a weapon, and the fighter can twist and press the advantage in the same movement. It predates the straight sword, which shows that people first learned to use an arc to control a blade at close quarters. Shu Han of course owned no such weapon; the counterpart in the Three Kingdoms arsenal is the ring-pommel dao, the standard issue of frontier garrisons and central armies since the Han, a straight two-edged blade with a ring pommel through which a cord could be passed so the weapon hung with its scabbard. It was made for cutting rather than thrusting, and Cao Pi's Dianlun on literature, in distinguishing sword from dao, praises the ring-pommel knife for its strength and its usefulness in battle, which shows that the straight double-edged sword still leaned towards dress and close-in stabbing. Standard infantry kit on both sides also included long halberds, white-plumed spears, large shields of willow-leaf and slab construction, iron helmets, lamellar armour and daggers. Shu was famous for its crossbows, including the repeating crossbow devised by Zhuge Liang, together with strong bow-driven crossbows and poisoned arrows, while Wei relied on heavy crossbows, horn bows and large quantities of arrows. Siege and defence equipment entered the line as well: scaling ladders, siege towers, wheeled siege towers, stone-throwers, the thunder-thrower already used to break a fleet in Cao Pi's war against Wu (recorded in the Wei Lue quoted in the commentary to the Sanguozhi), wooden abatis and deer-horn barricades. Supply tells the story as much as the fighting: Shu moved its grain on the wooden ox and the gliding horse, Wei relied on ox carts and horses, and the wooden and rope bridges and the plank roads of the Yinping track were the lifeline both sides fought over, while the dao, spear, halberd, bow and crossbow decided the last stretch of that narrow way.
tactics: 魏軍的戰略骨架是正壓劍閣、迂迴陰平。鍾會率主力自秦嶺入漢中，進抵劍閣，與姜維、諸葛瞻隔關相持；劍門關依山設險，蜀軍居高臨下以弓弩覆蓋狹窄關道，魏軍正面強攻極不划算，故鍾會一面佯攻，一面分兵偵察別路。中護軍諸葛緒本奉命出劍閣斷姜維後路，行至沓中，鍾會命其改道北上劍閣，姜維退保沓中，鍾會軍遂破關南下，兵鋒直指涪城。鄧艾則走陰平：以白裝步騎為主，盡棄輜重甲胄，士卒以氈自裹、推轉而下，攀木渡澗，循摩天嶺北麓的高山棧道直趨涪關；沿途橋梁多被毀斷，斷了姜維與成都之間的聯絡。鄧艾出涪，擊敗奉調北上的諸葛緒，取其眾、資器械，兵力驟增，再乘破竹之勢直下綿竹、雒縣。蜀軍這一步是被動的：諸葛瞻據城不出，黃崇力主出戰，後主又遣使持節催促，諸葛瞻乃出兵，士氣未整而陷陣，父子與黃崇同歿。鄧艾入雒縣，劉禪請降。補給上，魏軍主力糧道仍由漢中經劍閣維持，孤軍深入的鄧艾身後無援，所以全線只有速戰速決一條路；蜀軍的糧道同樣沿蜀道北段，劍閣一旦失守，成都與前線之間再無屏障。
tacticsEn: The Wei plan had two parts: pressure on Jiange from the front and movement through Yinping from behind. Zhong Hui took the main force from the Qinling into Hanzhong and up to Jiange, where he faced Jiang Wei and Zhuge Zhan across the pass. Jiange is a natural obstacle, the Shu holding the heights and covering the narrow road with bows and crossbows, so a frontal assault was badly uneconomic; Zhong Hui therefore pressed in appearance while sending detachments to look for another way. The colonel Zhongge Xu had been ordered to come out through Jiange and cut Jiang Wei's retreat, but having reached Tiaozhong he was told to turn north to Jiange instead. Jiang Wei withdrew to Tiaozhong, Zhong Hui broke through the pass and drove down towards Fucheng. Deng Ai took the Yinping road: his men went in light order without baggage or armour, wrapped themselves in felt and slid down, clambering over timber and fording the ravines, following the high plank road on the north side of Motian Ridge straight towards Fucheng. The bridges on the way were largely cut, severing Jiang Wei's link with Chengdu. Coming out at Fucheng, Deng Ai defeated Zhongge Xu, who had been ordered north, and took his men, his stores and his equipment; his numbers grew at once, and he pressed on like a bamboo split by the fist, through Mianzhu to Luoxian. The Shu response was passive: Zhuge Zhan stayed inside his walls, Huang Chong argued for a sortie, and the Later Lord sent an envoy with a tally urging him to fight, so Zhuge Zhan marched out, was broken before he could form, and died with his son and with Huang Chong. At Luoxian Liu Shan sent in his petition to surrender. On the logistics side Wei's main army still drew its grain from Hanzhong through Jiange, and Deng Ai, alone in enemy country with no support behind him, had no option but speed; Shu's own grain road ran along the same northern section of the Shu Road, and once Jiange fell there was no barrier left between Chengdu and the front.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，且多出自敵方記載，需存疑看待。魏方主力，《三國志·鍾會傳》記鍾會「率十餘萬衆自劍閣趣成都」，這是取其上限的說法，實際點兵當在此數之下；鄧艾偷渡陰平的偏師，裴松之注引《袁子》說他率眾二千餘人自陰平入山，是雙方記載中較小也較可信的一個數。陰平小徑的里程，鄧艾與蔣舒往來文書及後世記載多作七百里荒僻之地，山高谷深、橋梁多絕，途中需攀藤渡澗；從陰平到涪、從涪到綿竹與雒縣、從雒縣到成都，後段僅數十里至百餘里，鄧艾以一支輕裝偏師在蜀境內連下三城。時間線大致是七月下詔、八月分道出師、九月鍾會破劍閣、十月鄧艾破綿竹並進至雒縣、十一月劉禪遣使請降，自出師到亡國約三至四個月。守軍方面，劍閣一線姜維部以數萬計，綿竹諸葛瞻部亦數萬，蜀軍總兵力大致在十萬上下，蜀方常以「號二十萬」自壯聲勢。反過來，魏軍的損失缺少可靠數目，僅知綿竹攻城中魏軍亦有相當死傷；蜀方陣亡的高級將領有諸葛瞻、諸葛尚、黃崇三人。領土與人口方面，蜀亡後益州各郡縣改隸曹魏，《晉書·地理志》所載益州領戶約五十餘萬、口約百九十餘萬，屬官府控制數而非實測數。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, most of them come from enemy accounts, and they should be treated with care. The Wei main force is recorded in the biography of Zhong Hui in the Sanguozhi as more than a hundred thousand men moving from Jiange towards Chengdu, an upper limit rather than a count of men actually mustered. The detachment Deng Ai took through Yinping is put at a little over two thousand men by the Yuanzi quoted in Pei Songzhi's commentary, and that smaller figure, given in the accounts of both parties, is the more credible one. The length of the Yinping track is given in Deng Ai's correspondence with Jiang Shu and in later records as roughly seven hundred li of uninhabited country, with high ridges, deep ravines and many broken bridges, crossed by climbing vines and fording streams. From Yinping to Fucheng, from Fucheng to Mianzhu and Luoxian, and from Luoxian to Chengdu, the later stages run only a few tens of li or a little over a hundred, and a lightly equipped column took three cities in succession inside Shu territory. The calendar runs roughly as follows: the edict in the seventh month, the columns setting out in the eighth, Zhong Hui breaking Jiange in the ninth, Deng Ai breaking Mianzhu and reaching Luoxian in the tenth, and Liu Shan sending in his petition in the eleventh, three to four months from the start of the advance to the end of the state. On the Shu side Jiang Wei's men at Jiange and Zhuge Zhan's men at Mianzhu were each counted in the tens of thousands, and Shu's total force was on the order of a hundred thousand, though Shu habitually inflated the figure by claiming a host of two hundred thousand. Wei's losses are not credibly recorded, though Wei infantry certainly died in the assault on Mianzhu; the high-ranking Shu officers killed were Zhuge Zhan, Zhuge Shang and Huang Chong. In terms of territory and population, Yizhou's commanderies and counties passed back to Cao Wei after the fall, and the Jin Shu geography section gives a household count of a little over five hundred thousand and a population of a little under two million for Yizhou, figures of administrative control rather than a count of actual residents.
cause: 打起來有北方的準備，也有南方的空虛。曹魏自曹丕定漢中以來控制益州前線已六十餘年，太和、景初之間又先後平定孟達、毌丘儉、諸葛誕三次內亂，司馬氏在朝中的地位穩固。司馬昭要滅蜀，一半是消除蜀漢對北方的長期威脅——蜀漢據益州、帶甲二十萬，常據險挑釁——一半是為自己的篡位鋪路：滅蜀大功可以讓他超越前代權臣，獨享晉公之號，也讓他名正言順地進一步整合荊州與江南。蜀漢的弱點則在內部：姜維北伐十餘年，涼州、雍州、益州年年見血，青羌氐部與漢中百姓疲於轉運，國庫空虛；劍閣防線拉得過長，兵源枯竭，每次增兵都要從成都、梓潼一路抽調；大將軍諸葛瞻與中書令黃皓、尚書令董厥相互掣肘，黃皓因諸葛瞻父子的名望而抑之，後主劉禪又無力仲裁，譙周屢次上疏請罷姜維兵權而不聽。漢中的地形是關鍵：魏軍可以從陰平小徑繞過劍閣天險直插成都腹地，而蜀軍把重兵壓在劍閣一線，正中魏軍所求——不必硬攻劍閣，只要有人肯走那條沒有人肯走的路。
causeEn: There was preparation in the north and emptiness in the south. Wei had held the Yizhou front for more than sixty years since Cao Pi secured Hanzhong, and between the Tahe and Jingchu periods it had put down three rebellions in a row, those of Meng Da, Guanqiu Jian and Zhuge Dan, which left the Sima family's position at court secure. Half of Sima Zhao's purpose was to remove a permanent threat, for Shu Han sat on Yizhou with a score of armoured men and habitually challenged the north from its strong ground; the other half was to pave the way for his own usurpation. A war that destroyed Shu would let him surpass the weightier ministers before him, hold the title of Duke of Jin alone, and give him a respectable reason to integrate Jingzhou and the south. Shu's weakness lay within. Jiang Wei had campaigned north for more than a decade, and Liang, Yong and Yi bled every year to supply the armies; the Qiang and Di of the border and the commoners of Hanzhong were worn out by transport, and the treasury was empty. The line at Jiange was stretched too far, the manpower dried up, and every reinforcement had to be pulled out of Chengdu and Zitong in reverse. The General of Chariots Zhuge Zhan was obstructed by the eunuch Huang Hao and the Master of Ceremonies Dong Jiao, the Later Lord Liu Shan had no power to arbitrate between them, and Qiao Zhou petitioned repeatedly to strip Jiang Wei of his command without being heard. The geography of Hanzhong was the key: Wei could send an army round the natural barrier of Jiange and into the belly of Chengdu, and Shu had packed its strength into the single line at Jiange, which was exactly what Wei wanted, since Jiange did not have to be assaulted at all, only bypassed, provided someone was willing to take the road nobody was willing to take.
impact: 蜀漢四十三年的國祚在景元四年十一月終結，三國鼎立的局面從此只剩曹魏與東吳，天下統一的時間表被大幅前移。對曹魏與後來的西晉而言，最大的一筆收穫是完整拿下益州：蜀地的糧源、馬匹、銅冶、蜀錦，以及最要緊的蜀道，全部歸入朝廷，漢中與劍閣不再是前線，而變成通往西南的走廊，晉得以在此設益州牧屯田；兩年後司馬炎代魏建晉，再隔十餘年平吳，統一的皇帝終於重新站在洛陽對著南方。人口的流動也未停止：蜀地士人北遷，蜀中豪族勢力被拆散，三國末年大規模南遷的浪潮繼續東移。戰後的清算同樣重要：鍾會在姜維策劃下圖謀叛逆被平，鍾會與姜維一併被殺，姜維諸子亦死，蜀漢舊將中被牽連者不少，蜀末尚存的精銳部隊從此不復存在；兩名統帥在短時間內先後死亡，魏內部對統兵大將的猜忌加深，為往後晉室內亂埋下隱患。對東吳而言，蜀亡使其失去唯一可聯手的對手，孫皓當政後無制衡之力，二宮之亂隨即爆發，吳亦於280年覆亡。另一層延續是技術的轉移：蜀漢在山地戰與器械上的積累——連弩、木牛流馬、棧道軍需體系——大部被魏軍繼承改進，蜀中匠人北調，成為曹魏軍工系統的新血。
impactEn: Shu Han's forty-three years of statehood ended in the eleventh month of Jingyuan 4, and the three-way balance of kingdoms came down to Wei and Wu alone, pulling the timetable of unification well forward. For Cao Wei, and for Western Jin after it, the largest single prize was Yizhou entire: the grain, horses, copper, Sichuan brocade and, most of all, the roads of Shu passed into the hands of the court, and Hanzhong and Jiange ceased to be a frontier, becoming instead a corridor to the southwest where Jin set up a governor of Yizhou with military farms; two years later Sima Yan replaced Wei with Jin, and a little over a decade after that Wu fell, so that an emperor at Luoyang once again faced the south from a united realm. The movement of people did not stop either: officers from Shu were summoned north to Luoyang, the great local families of Shu were broken up, and the great southern migration of the late third century carried on eastward. The settling of accounts after the victory mattered as much. The rebellion plotted by Zhong Hui under Jiang Wei's guidance was put down, Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei were both killed, Jiang Wei's sons as well, a number of former Shu officers were implicated, and the trained companies Shu had still possessed ceased to exist. The deaths of both commanders within a short span deepened Wei's suspicion of its own generals, a seed of the trouble that would break out inside the Jin house later. For Wu the loss of Shu removed its only possible partner, and Sun Hao was left without a check; the palace coups of the Two Palaces followed, and Wu too went under. One inheritance ran the other way as well: Shu's accumulation in mountain warfare and machinery, the repeating crossbow, the wooden ox and gliding horse and the plank-road supply system, was largely inherited and improved by the victor, and the craftsmen of Shu were summoned north to become new blood in the Wei arsenal.
result: 景元四年十一月，劉禪遣使奉皇帝璽綬、印綬、節、旄、鉞、刀劍與成都城門之符降於鄧艾；鄧艾受降後即遣護軍率兵護送劉禪前往成都，鍾會主力亦自劍閣趕到，劉禪轉而面鍾會降，蜀漢就此覆亡。姜維在劍閣兵敗後率眾退往雒縣一帶，亦向鍾會投降，被遷居鍾會營中。他不甘心，勸鍾會乘勢在成都稱帝，又勸其盡誅劉禪及蜀中諸貴妃、公卿，鍾會猶豫未決，事情卻洩漏，部將反戈攻殺鍾會，鍾會與姜維一併被殺，姜維諸子亦死，鍾會弟鍾邕坐免。鄧艾則因功高遭忌，監軍衛瓘奉司馬昭之命將其逮捕，以檻車押往洛陽，押解途中被護衛殺害，一說病歿於是年，司馬昭聞訊後深悔。蜀地其後由魏及後來的晉重編郡縣、設益州牧，蜀中士人或被徵召北遷、或就地屯田，蜀漢作為獨立政權的歷史正式落幕。
resultEn: In the eleventh month of Jingyuan 4 Liu Shan sent an envoy carrying the imperial seals, the seals of office, the tally, the banners, the axes of authority, the swords and the tokens of the gates of Chengdu, and surrendered to Deng Ai. Deng Ai received the surrender and sent a commander with an escort to bring Liu Shan to Chengdu; the main army of Zhong Hui also arrived from Jiange, and Liu Shan surrendered in person to Zhong Hui. Shu Han was finished. Jiang Wei, defeated at Jiange, led his men back towards Luoxian and surrendered there to Zhong Hui, who moved him into his own quarters. Unwilling to accept it, Jiang Wei urged Zhong Hui to proclaim himself emperor at Chengdu while the momentum lasted, and to kill Liu Shan and the Shu consorts and ministers without reserve; Zhong Hui hesitated, the affair leaked, and his own officers fell on him, killing both Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei, and Jiang Wei's sons as well, while Zhong Hui's brother Zhong Yong was cashiered and exiled. Deng Ai, whose achievement had made him a target, was arrested by the commissioner Wei Guan on Sima Zhao's order, put in a caged cart and sent towards Luoyang, and was killed on the road by his escort, or, as some accounts have it, died of illness there that year; Sima Zhao heard of it and regretted it deeply. Shu was then reorganised under Wei, and later under Jin, with commanderies and counties redrawn and a governor of Yizhou installed; former Shu officers were either summoned north to serve or settled on the land in place, and the history of Shu Han as an independent state was formally closed.
